parsed.note: Changing WARMUP_RATIO only alters training dynamics and leaves the fixed eval (shard 12, held out from TRAIN_SHARDS 0-11) untouched, so val_bpb still measures real quality, though the post's claim that 1.028 beats 1.001 looks inverted since lower bpb is better.
